title: Magnify
suits: detection and search claims: anomaly detection, monitoring, inspection, fraud, defects, 'finds the needle in the haystack'

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: field; the lens rim, handle and mark badge (brand); the map's tint (brand-2)
params.--st-magnify-ember: the colour the hidden cells glow (ember by default)
params.HOT: the two hidden cells (column, row) in the script; the lens rests between them

details: the map is about 10,000 real cells: soft heat-map noise, lighter streets every 13 cells and a winding river
outside the lens the two hidden cells look like every other cell
inside the lens the map is 3.6× closer and the cells become rounded tiles with visible gaps
each hidden cell heats up only as the lens reaches it; the second lights a beat late
a soft ember glow around each, which keeps a faint out-of-step flicker after rest (ambient)
rings close around both cells once the lens has settled
the lens glides on a curve, overshoots and settles on a damped spring
its shadow is drawn from 70 ms earlier, so it lags and catches up
the lens tilts and the handle swings with the inertia, then hang straight
the glass reflection slides against the motion
a ring of darker glass at the rim, a double edge on the rim so a white brand still reads
the product's mark pops onto the rim at the end
a faint dot grid on the field fades out towards the map
